## Legal Home (LH)

The GC’s morning glance: the contract book by pipeline stage, what is out for signature (waiting on someone else), and what expires within 60 days (waiting on us — reusing Contract’s own daysToExpiry). Live-queried, click-to-open via callback.

### Non-goals

No matters/disputes tracking — this is the contract book’s home, not a legal-ops suite.
